detected_fault: Intel Core i9-14900HX CPU instability with RTX 4070 Laptop GPU
suggested_solution: Gather and upload minidump files for accurate analysis of BSODs.
Test the system with a stress testing tool, such as Prime95 or OCCT, to identify any CPU-related issues.
Verify that the BIOS is up-to-date and check for any firmware updates.
Consider reinstalling the Intel XTU driver and adjusting the power limits to their default settings.
Investigate potential software conflicts with G-Helper and Unreal Engine.
